lead: Movable appliances that heat, cool, move, clean or dry the air of a room — heaters, window and portable air conditioners, fans, air purifiers, humidifiers and dehumidifiers — organised by what the appliance does to the air, then by kind, with built-in heating, cooling, ventilation, water and energy systems living in Home Fixtures & Features.

depts.note: Plug-in or fuel-fed heaters a person moves between rooms; stoves, fires, boilers, radiators and towel rails are built-ins and move to G3.

b.m: Heat output matched to the room
b.v: kW or BTU; W per m² rule of thumb
b.w: Size comes before anything else; Which? and Consumer Reports both test by room size.

b.v: pence or cents per hour at rated power; fuel type
b.w: Electric heaters are all near 100% efficient, so cost is set by tariff and fuel, not by the heater.

b.v: tip-over and overheat cut-outs; CO and oxygen-depletion sensors on gas and kerosene
b.w: Portable heaters lead home-fire statistics; unflued fuel heaters add CO risk.
Fan heaters run close to people; oil and panel heaters are silent.
Features come after output and safety.

s.brief: Tier mode: cut each kind to 5–12 market-covering makers (De'Longhi, Dyson, Dimplex, Vornado, Lasko, Honeywell, Stiebel Eltron, Rowenta, Mill, Toyotomi, Corona, Dainichi, Mr. Heater, Calor) plus independent test winners (Which?, Consumer Reports, Stiftung Warentest, CHOICE). Merge heat lamp into radiant heater as a type; drop the Broan built-in bathroom heater. Split the flueless kind into kerosene and portable gas. Add electric fireplace/stove heater as a new kind. Micathermic and panel heaters become types of convector heater, not kinds.

k.brief: Types: ceramic, bladeless hot+cool, bathroom-safe, personal/desk. Keep Dyson Hot+Cool as a model, not the Purifier range.
Types: panel convector, micathermic, wall-mountable plug-in; add leaders (De'Longhi, Dimplex, Mill, Stiebel Eltron).
Acova and Reina models are plumbed designer radiators — move those to the moves list with k14/k15 or drop; replace with De'Longhi, Dimplex, Pelonis, Vornado test winners.
Types: quartz bar, halogen, heat lamp, carbon fibre. Absorb the infrared heat lamp kind as a type.
Plug-in wall or ceiling panels incl. picture and mirror panels; cut Heat Storm SKU list to 1–2, add European leaders (Herschel, Könighaus, Trotec).
NEW: freestanding electric stove or fireplace heater with flame effect (Dimplex Opti-myst, Duraflame); inset and wall-recessed electric fires are fixtures (G3).
Types: wick/convection, fan-forced, radiant; Japanese leaders Corona, Toyotomi, Dainichi, plus Sengoku/Kero-World in the US. Keep Bromic and Mr. Heater gas models for the next kind.
NEW: cabinet (butane/propane bottle) and catalytic heaters incl. Mr. Heater Buddy, Calor/Campingaz cabinet heaters, Bromic; note flueless safety.

depts.note: Window and portable air conditioners, evaporative coolers and plug-in fans; split, cassette, ducted systems and ceiling fans are fixtures (G3).

b.m: Cooling capacity matched to the room
b.v: BTU/h or kW; SACC for portables (US DOE)
b.w: Portable units are rated by SACC, which is lower than the headline BTU.

b.v: CEER (US window units); EU energy label

b.w: Bedroom use decides most purchases; RTINGS and Consumer Reports publish dB.

b.v: CFM or m³/min; oscillation; DC motor
b.w: Fans are compared on airflow per watt and noise, not on power.
Dual-hose portables cool better; drainage sets convenience.

s.brief: Tier mode: market-covering brands (Midea, LG, Frigidaire, GE, Haier, De'Longhi, Black+Decker, Whynter, Honeywell, Olimpia Splendid, EcoFlow) plus Wirecutter/Consumer Reports/Which? winners. Add evaporative cooler as a new kind; through-the-wall and U-shaped units are types of window AC, not kinds.

k.brief: Types: standard window, U-shaped/saddle (Midea U), through-the-wall sleeve, inverter.
Types: single-hose, dual-hose, heat-pump (heats too), battery/portable-power (EcoFlow Wave). Keep WAVE 3.
NEW: swamp/desert cooler for dry climates (Honeywell, Hessaire, Symphony, Bajaj, Portacool); note it is not an air conditioner.

s.brief: Tier mode: trim Vornado SKU list to 2–3 per kind; add Dyson, Lasko, Honeywell, Rowenta, Balmuda, Xiaomi/Smartmi, Meaco, Duux, Iris Ohyama. Bladeless (Dyson Cool) is a type under tower and desk fans, not a kind. Misting and outdoor fans belong to C2 Garden; ceiling, extractor and whole-house fans to G3.

k.brief: Types: table, USB, bladeless, clip-on desk.
Types: DC-motor quiet, oscillating, bladeless pedestal. Balmuda GreenFan is the test-winning reference.
Types: bladeless (Dyson Cool), fan-purifier combos cross-link to air purifier.
Cut 12 Vornado SKUs to 2–3 (630, 660, 783); add Iris Ohyama Woozoo, Honeywell TurboForce, Lasko.
Lasko and Hurricane cover the market; one or two models.
Types: twin reversible, single; Bionaire, Holmes, Vornado Transom.
Types: wall-mounted oscillating, clip fan, stroller/cot clip fan (tag baby).
Powered hand-held and neck fans (JisuLife, Torras, Francfranc); plain folding hand fans stay in A4.

depts.note: Room appliances that filter, humidify or dry the air; whole-house and ducted units are fixtures (G3).

b.m: Clean-air delivery rate for the room
b.v: CADR (AHAM) smoke/dust/pollen; m²; 4.8 air changes per hour
b.w: CADR is the independent yardstick used by AHAM, Which?, Consumer Reports and Wirecutter.

b.v: HEPA H13/true HEPA; activated carbon; filter price per year
b.w: Filters cost more than the machine over its life.

b.v: litres or pints per day at the rated condition (DOE 65°F/60% RH; 30°C/80% RH)
b.w: Shoppers choose humidifiers and dehumidifiers by capacity first.

b.v: dB on sleep and top settings

b.w: Humidifier hygiene depends on cleaning; Wirecutter weights it heavily.

s.brief: Tier mode: add the tier leaders named in the findings (Dyson, Blueair, Coway, IQAir) plus Levoit, Winix, Honeywell, Philips, Sharp, Daikin, Xiaomi, Molekule, Austin Air; cut Levoit SKU list to 2–3. Dissolve air deodoriser and ion generator into types of air purifier. One replacement-filter entry only. Add an indoor air-quality monitor as a new kind, cross-linked to E6 if weather stations live there.

k.brief: Types: HEPA tower, desktop/compact, purifier-fan (Dyson), purifier-humidifier, ioniser/plasma (Sharp Plasmacluster), deodoriser (Panasonic ziaino), medical-grade (IQAir HealthPro).
Single spare-parts entry for purifier, humidifier and dehumidifier filters; cut Levoit SKUs to one line per brand, note genuine vs third-party.
NEW: CO2/PM2.5/VOC room monitors (Aranet4, Awair, Airthings, IKEA Vindstyrka, Qingping); CO alarms stay in B8, weather stations in E6.

s.brief: Tier mode: humidifier leaders Levoit, Dyson, Venta, Stadler Form, Honeywell, Vicks, Dainichi, Panasonic, Sharp; dehumidifier leaders Meaco, Midea, Frigidaire, hOmeLabs, EcoAir, De'Longhi, Mitsubishi Electric, Pro Breeze, with Which?/Consumer Reports winners. Whole-house dehumidifiers move to G3.

k.brief: Types: ultrasonic, evaporative, warm-mist/steam, hybrid, humidifier-purifier (Dyson, Sharp); tag baby for nursery cool-mist models.
Types: compressor/refrigerant, desiccant, mini thermoelectric (Peltier), laundry-drying mode; source currently empty — attest the kind.
Unpowered tubs and hanging bags (DampRid, Unibond Aero 360, Kilrock); refill packs as a type.
